integrity: The primary open-access PDF was inspected at Eqs. (6.11)-(6.25), including the density, normalization assertion, moment display, survival asymptotic, and likelihood. The 2011 Mittag-Leffler review was inspected at its statistical-distribution section. The bundled checker is supplementary; the main conclusions follow from exact series differentiation and tail integration.
scientific_limitations: The NGDTM differential-equation theorems outside the proposed FED construction are not assessed.
The complete closed form of fractional moments below the sharp threshold is not required for this finding.
Numerical maximum-likelihood experiments are not rerun; only the analytic likelihood correction is established.
title: The proposed FED has mass alpha and reduces to the classical Mittag-Leffler law after normalization
